blindSummary: A mid-2026 national legal-risk assessment groups this state/province, with a handful of other jurisdictions, among those that have passed one or two laws targeting transgender adults, or several targeting transgender youth, but records no facility ban for adults here and no protective statute.
blindSourceSummaries: An anti-trans national legal-risk assessment map, mid-2026 update (reposted by an LGBTQ news site): this state/province appears in the map's middle grouping — jurisdictions that "have either passed one or two laws aimed at transgender adults or have enacted multiple laws targeting transgender youth, or are advancing negative laws quickly" — ranked below the map's two most severe groupings and above its protective groupings.
